desc: Ideate the marginal-cost threshold binary search approach, including safe hi, capping, and final partial-block handling.
Write a compact Python 3 solution (code only) using filter P_i > M, sort/group, safe hi (optionally tightened by prefix sum), capped binary search, exact final count/cost, and output answer.
Verify edge cases and performance: all P_i > M, N=1, exact budget, ties/multiple products at same marginal cost, maximum constraints; ensure O(N log hi) with early break/cap and correct stdin/stdout.
